column1: # Guest addresses of Killzone HD's EBOOT.elf, US (NPUA80856, SHA-256 c81aa91e...03fc) to EU (NPEA00418, SHA-256
# e4fc4f13...7f52). Numbers only. Same source and compiler: the EU link drops 0xE8 bytes of code in 11 changed
# functions and 3 gaps between functions, so the code after them moves by a growing step, and the rodata after it
# moves by 0x100 (one run of strings differs); data and bss keep their addresses (2026-11-24, Ghidra 12.1.4 and a
# linear walk of .text). tools/edition_map.py writes port/kz1hd/edition.h from it and checks it against both EBOOTs.
#   range    us_start..us_end moves to eu_start..eu_end (same length): every word outside the changed rows is the
#   changed  code (or data) that differs: a changed function's start maps to eu_start; nothing inside a changed row
#            has an EU address unless a site row proves one; a walk row (bytes between functions, rodata) has none
#   site     one address inside a changed function, matched in the EU EBOOT (the note gives the evidence)
# source: ghidra,lift (both function lists call it changed), lift (only the lift's list,
# work/lift/analysis/functions.json, delimits it), walk (the linear walk), ghidra (a headless Ghidra script).
